chronology: Specified after the earlier DGCNN results were known and after extension training began; not a preregistration or an untouched confirmation analysis.
aggregation: source draws and selector subsets inside seed; training seeds inside outer target
p_value_scope: Conditional working-model diagnostics requiring coordinatewise sign invariance of paired differences. Overlapping fitted source populations are not made independent by aggregation, rank tests, or Holm correction.
multiplicity: Holm across all 63 contrasts separately for the mean and rank test engines; within-family results are supplemental only.
